name: tumor protein p53

function.text: TP53 encodes the p53 transcription factor, a tumor suppressor that coordinates cellular stress responses through cell-cycle arrest, DNA repair, senescence, and apoptosis.

germline.text: Germline pathogenic variants cause autosomal dominant Li-Fraumeni syndrome, which predisposes to a broad spectrum of cancers, notably early-onset breast cancer, sarcomas, central nervous system tumors, and adrenocortical carcinoma.

somatic.text: Somatic TP53 mutations occur across many cancer types. The biological effect varies by alteration, and a tumor-detected TP53 variant alone does not establish a germline diagnosis.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Tumor-suppressor dysfunction; individual variants require assessment.
